meta.source: Generic demonstration rubric written for LINGUA. Replace with your own evaluation criteria.

criteria.title: Task completion
criteria.description: Covers every part of the task with relevant, developed ideas.

criteria.title: Organisation
criteria.description: Clear paragraphs, logical order and appropriate linking words.

criteria.title: Vocabulary range
criteria.description: Uses varied and accurate vocabulary suited to the topic.

criteria.title: Grammatical accuracy
criteria.description: Uses a range of structures with few errors that affect meaning.
